hierarchyPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit — typography hierarchy refinement.
Edit this exact 1983 x 793 approved IPL three-player banner. CHANGE ONLY the secondary slogan treatment and CASHBACK placement.

1. KEEP "50%" EXACTLY its current vivid champagne-gold color/material, bright highlights, shape, size and location. It must remain the clearest and most visually dominant wording. Do not desaturate, dim or recolor any part of 50%.
2. Weaken "CRICKET" and "UP TO": shift their faces from bright gold to a lower-contrast warm ivory/stone champagne; substantially reduce glossy highlights, extrusion intensity and surrounding flare. CRICKET may shrink approximately 8% in place to further subordinate it. Keep UP TO very readable.
3. Weaken "CASHBACK": retain its green color family but make it muted pistachio/sage (#BED889 family, darker and less luminous than now), with reduced bright outer glow, lower shine and simpler bevels. It remains clearly readable but no longer competes with 50%.
4. Move the CASHBACK line UP by roughly 30–35 pixels. Layer it BEHIND the gold 50%, so only the very top edges of a few CASHBACK letters tuck behind the lower edge of 50%, a restrained overlap of about 10–15% of CASHBACK's letter height. Keep the word's identity and complete readability. The gold 50% is always in FRONT and is never covered. Do not replace the overlap with a separate box, and do not shrink the offer number.
5. Reduce secondary red/green light streaks around the smaller text a little, keeping the overall dynamic diagonal alignment.

Everything else must be preserved: all THREE recognizable faces, exact team kits, natural body proportions and player poses/placement, Iyer's fully visible red lower body and leg pads, Pant center foreground, Bumrah right with small ball IN HIS RAISED HAND, all bats, IPL logo, the stadium, grass, frame and proportions. There is NO large foreground cricket ball, and it must NOT return. No extra text, CTA, names, dates, claims, props, crop or logo changes. Preserve original 1983 x 793 full-bleed opaque canvas.
